columns.name: prep_min
columns.description: Preparation time in minutes for the recipe

columns.name: num_ingredients
columns.description: Number of ingredients in the recipe, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: includes_baking_soda_and_serves_10_or_more_people
columns.description: Set to 1 if the recipe includes baking soda and serves 10 or more people, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: contains_vitamin_that_helps_vision
columns.description: Set to 1 if the recipe contains a vitamin that helps vision in dim light, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: is_good_for_wound_healing
columns.description: Set to 1 if the recipe is good for wound healing, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: contains_cheese_and_calories_greater_than_200
columns.description: Set to 1 if the recipe contains cheese and the calories are greater than 200, otherwise, set to 0. Contains cheese refers to ingredients that include the word "cheese" in their name.
